terminal_question.name: FO4CycleOverlapRankRigidityDichotomy
terminal_question.weakest_sufficient_form: For fixed finite parameters Delta and R, and for a fixed FO4 radius-R rooted local type notion, prove exactly one branch: either a uniform bound B(Delta,R) on R-local cycle-overlap rank for every connected finite graph of maximum degree at most Delta whose vertices share one FO4 radius-R rooted type, or a connected finite graph family with unbounded R-local cycle-overlap rank whose vertices share one FO4 radius-R rooted type.

blocked_until: formal definition of FO4 radius-R rooted local type inside this repo
formal definition of R-local cycle-overlap rank inside this repo
proof of rigidity branch or explicit counterexample-family branch
conditional_downstream: If the rigidity branch is proved, this repo may support a narrow FO4 local-rigidity input.
If the counterexample branch is proved, unrestricted FO4 local-rigidity promotion is refuted at this surface.
